title: thlaspi stenocarpum
intro: Thlaspi stenocarpum, commonly known as Kashmir rockcress, is a plant species that belongs to the Brassicaceae family. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including respiratory issues and wounds, due to its multiple health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Thlaspi stenocarpum include its ability to act as a bronchodilator, reducing inflammation and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of Thlaspi stenocarpum include glucosinolates, which are responsible for its medicinal properties, including its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory activities.
